answer.justification: The space posterior to the stomach is the lesser sac (omental bursa). The gastrohepatic ligament, the hepatogastric part of the lesser omentum, forms part of its anterior boundary and can be divided to enter it. The phrenoesophageal and phrenicocolic ligaments and the ligamentum venosum are not the surgical route to this space.
